evals.query: Which browsers can I test on with TestingBot?
expected_behavior: Calls the getBrowsers MCP tool
Does NOT invent browser names or version numbers
If MCP is unavailable, points at GET /v1/browsers or testingbot.com/browsers

evals.query: My last TestingBot test failed, why?
expected_behavior: Calls getTests to find the session
Calls getTestDetails and/or getFailureLogs
Does not speculate about the cause before reading logs

evals.query: I don't have my TestingBot API key, how do I authenticate?
expected_behavior: Suggests the tb_login tool for browser-based OAuth
Does NOT ask the user to paste a key or secret into the chat
Mentions TESTINGBOT_KEY / TESTINGBOT_SECRET env vars as the CI path

evals.query: Set up Selenium in Java to run on Chrome on Windows 11 via TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses https://hub.testingbot.com/wd/hub
Reads credentials from environment variables, never literals
Puts TestingBot-specific keys inside tb:options, not at the top level
Sets both name and build

evals.query: Can I test my app on localhost:3000 with TestingBot?
expected_behavior: Explains that a tunnel is required
Gives the java -jar testingbot-tunnel.jar command or the launcher package
Mentions repointing the hub URL to http://localhost:4445/wd/hub
Mentions waiting for 'You may start tests'

evals.query: Run my tests against https://staging.example.com on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Does NOT set up a tunnel for a publicly reachable URL
Writes plain cloud config

evals.query: All my TestingBot tests show as 'incomplete' in the dashboard
expected_behavior: Identifies that nothing is reporting pass/fail
Gives the PUT /v1/tests/:session_id call with test[success]
Puts the call in a teardown hook so it runs on failure too
Suggests the framework's TestingBot service/plugin where one exists

evals.query: Clean up my old TestingBot builds
expected_behavior: Lists builds before deleting anything
Confirms with the user before calling deleteBuild
Notes that deleting a build also deletes its tests

evals.query: Run my Appium test on a real Android device on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses the hub URL with key/secret
Checks getDevices rather than inventing a device model
Uses appium: prefixed capabilities and tb:options with realDevice: true
References the uploaded app as tb://APP_ID or a public URL
Suggests a deviceName pattern rather than pinning one exact model

evals.query: Write a unit test for my date formatting function
expected_behavior: Does NOT mention TestingBot or cloud testing
Writes a plain local unit test

evals.query: Set up Nightwatch to run on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses a webdriver block with start_process: false, host hub.testingbot.com, port 443, default_path_prefix /wd/hub, ssl true
Puts key and secret inside tb:options
Does NOT use top-level username / access_key keys
Adds a custom command using testingbot-api to report pass/fail
